meta.parties: The Bank of Chettinad. Ltd. v. Thambiah Et Al

rules.statement: A corporation can have a dual residence, but for the purposes of section 25(b) of the Civil Procedure Code, it is not considered resident within the jurisdiction of the District Court of Colombo if its primary operations and registration are outside that jurisdiction.
rules.supporting_quote: "The word 'Resident' has a variety of meanings just as much as the word 'residence' which Erle C.J. said has a variety of meanings according to the statute in which it is used."
